extraction.document_summary: AIA Diabetes Care is a critical illness insurance plan targeted at Type 2 diabetics and pre-diabetics. It is designed to provide easier access: eligibility is stated as requiring the insured to be a non-smoker with diabetes diagnosed after age 25 and no pre-existing diabetes-related complications, and the brochure says coverage access is possible “without the need for medical examinations” by answering “5 simple questions”. The core protection covers five diabetes-related critical illnesses (blindness, coronary artery bypass surgery, specified-severity heart attack, end stage kidney failure, and stroke with permanent neurological deficit) with a payout of either the full coverage amount or “110% of the total annual premiums paid”, whichever is higher. Coverage is “guaranteed renewable” and the premium remains “the same throughout the whole policy, up to age 80”. It also pays an extra 20% of the coverage amount for specified diabetes-related limb amputation (one-time, and only if no critical illness benefit payout has been made). An optional Cancer Cover rider can add 20% for early/intermediate cancer and a further 100% for major cancer, subject to one-time payout conditions.
quality_notes: The brochure provides clear descriptions of key covered events and payout mechanics.
Age range is stated for eligibility (30 to 65) and premium guarantee is stated up to age 80, but full policy term details and exact waiting/survival periods are not provided.
No specific numeric annual/lifetime limits are stated in the brochure.

policies.quick_summary: Critical illness coverage tailored for Type 2 diabetics and pre-diabetics with guaranteed renewability and level premium up to age 80, accessible without medical examinations (via 5 questions). Covers five diabetes-related critical illnesses with payout of full coverage amount or 110% of total annual premiums paid (whichever higher), plus an extra 20% payout for specified diabetes-related limb amputation (subject to payout conditions). Optional Cancer Cover rider is add-on protection with additional stage-based cancer payouts (20% early/intermediate and a further 100% for major cancer). Use conditions/eligibility and one-time payout limits.

policies.coverage_term_description: Guaranteed renewable and premium remains the same throughout the whole policy, up to age 80.
important_caveats: Eligibility requires non-smoker, diabetes diagnosed after age 25, and no pre-existing diabetes-related complications.
The brochure states that there are certain conditions whereby no benefits will be payable, and that waiting period and survival period are applicable before benefits will be payable.
One-time payout conditions apply for the amputation extra payout and for cancer rider payouts (cancer rider) as described in notes.

riders.name: Cancer Cover (optional add-on)
riders.description: Optional Cancer Cover add-on to bolster the plan. Pays 20% of the coverage amount upon diagnosis of early or intermediate stage cancer, and pays a further 100% of the coverage amount upon diagnosis of major cancer. The payouts are conditional on one-time payout conditions: early/intermediate is payable only once and provided there is no payout made for major cancer.
riders.notes: In addition to coverage from the main plan.
